authenticity.evidence: Breadth looks strong: about 3,600 unique buyers and about 3,500 holders only 35 minutes after the pair was created. Top 10 holders own only 12.6%. No insider networks were found, sniper and bundler holdings are near zero, the GMGN bot/degen rate is 0.12%, and the dev has no prior launches. The X account has no rename history, and no paid DexScreener ads or boosts were found. The warning sign is the ratio of unique buyers to unique sellers: 3,629 to 364, about 10:1. Buy transactions outnumber sells about 5.5:1. The average buy is about $75-90. A ratio that lopsided can be real FOMO, but it is also the fingerprint of bots spreading many small buys across many wallets to inflate holder and buyer counts. The dev has sold out (creator_close), and the coin is flagged as a community takeover.
authenticity.uncertainty: I have no X posts or web data to check whether real outside attention is driving the buying. The wallet classifications may miss well-built micro-buy farms.

structural_risks: Liquidity of about $45k against a $250k market cap. That is fine at this size, but sells from early buyers sitting on +150% will move the price hard.
The creator has sold everything, so no team is supporting the price. The coin carries a community-takeover label.
The buyer/seller skew may come from bots spreading small buys across many wallets, which can stop abruptly.
Price is already up about 150% in an hour and sits near its all-time high of about $271k, so the entry is chasing the move.
Mint and freeze authorities are renounced and the LP is 100% burned, so a classic liquidity pull is unlikely.

structured_output.counterargument: The case for going higher than 32: 3,600 distinct buyers in 35 minutes and a flat holder distribution are rare for a manufactured pump. The last 5 minutes still show 289 new buyers against 42 sellers, momentum is not fading, and nothing is paid for on DexScreener. Real viral cat memes with this profile often run from $250k to $1M+ within hours, which would clear +100% easily. The case for going much lower: the dev has exited, and first-hour holders on +150% could dump at the 25-minute entry. If the breadth is a bot farm, a -50% stop from about $250k is only about $125k away, which is easy to reach.

structured_output.thesis: This is a fresh cat meme with unusually broad early participation: about 3,600 unique buyers, a flat holder distribution, burned LP and clean dev flags. Those facts make a hard liquidity-pull rug unlikely and give a real chance of reaching about $500k market cap. Against that, the dev has exited, the price is already up about 150% near its high, and the 10:1 buyer-to-seller skew may be bot-inflated. Without confirmation from X, I put the chance of doubling before halving slightly under the 1/3 break-even: p_runner is 32, which is below the 35 entry threshold, so no position is taken.
